Here is diff to spec if somebody needs it: https://gist.github.com/rakita/d26c48caf82acd1492a433ef3f30fab5 I'm getting this error when using `--syncmode full`: ``` INFO [02-13|12:29:14.199] Block synchronisation started INFO [02-13|12:29:14.818] Looking for peers peercount=1 tried=90 static=0 WARN [02-13|12:29:16.026] Node data write error err="trie node b205a0…769afa failed with all peers (1 tries, 1 peers)" INFO [02-13|12:29:16.026] Downloader queue stats receiptTasks=0 blockTasks=0 itemSize=0.00B throttle=8192 WARN [02-13|12:29:16.026] Synchronisation failed, retrying err="trie node b205a0…769afa failed with all peers (1 tries, 1 peers)" ``` if I try `--syncmode snap` it grabs the headers but isn't pulling any states/receipts. This is using `Geth/v1.10.0-unstable-0ebac584-20210213/darwin-amd64/go1.15.5` from `lightclient/impl-eip-2718` maybe I should be using a different branch? `--syncmode fast` gives the same error about trie b205a0 did you change the chainId as well as the network id? https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/21502/commits/0ebac58401a9ab6893705900f6c7275b10e42da6#diff-10ff00a15ef58da7485fedeca3906c73cb236fde4b143a9d61601c63cbf1ffe8R218 ChainID if not set, becomes same as NetworkID Both networkid and chainid changed, yes That commit ^ contains changes to both See my gist <@388751025789468672> did you wipe the datadir first?
